From Maciej: <@U04CZK4K7P0> (and <@U06CCFTNBS6>), wanted to go through a small restructuring on Asana this week to try and hopefully simplify our active R&D projects, provide better visibility, and better tie in with the Kanban board. We'll discuss tomorrow, but at a high level the plan will be:

• *Two-level planning:* Asana tracks long-term milestones and upcoming weekly tasks; our existing physical Kanban board manages weekly engineering execution.
• *6-month rolling milestone plan:* Each
